caption_L1: This is a bar diagram called Ecuador : Budget balance between 2015 to 2025 in relation to GDP. Year is measured using a categorical scale with 2010 on one end and 2025* at the other on the x-axis. Budget balance in relation to GDP is shown with a categorical scale from −0.08 to 0.02 along the y-axis.
caption_L2L3: Fifteen years of data is shown. A block, of the first 11 of the 15 years, show negative values. Only the last 4 years show positive values. The lowest budget balance was in 2020 at -0.09. The second lowest budget balance was in 2016 at just over -0.08. The final two years 2024 and 2025 are the only two above 0.02.
